name: Ca kho boi U Minh
summary: Cá khô bổi U Minh is dried sặc rằn, a collective trademark of Trần Văn Thời. VOV says the fish grows more slowly here and the dried flesh is firm and fragrant.
origin: U Minh, in Trần Văn Thời. VOV on 24 October 2020 and Nhân Dân on 23 December 2022 both name the mark.
howToEat: Carry it as dried fish. Neither VOV nor Nhân Dân prints a cooking method or a price. Check on arrival.
where: Trần Văn Thời, the district VOV names for the mark. No stall is named. Check on arrival.
